bold_solid.description: bold, filled or visually heavy glyph

illustrative_drawn.description: drawn or pictorial illustration rather than a utility glyph

duotone.description: two-tone icon with explicit layer semantics

brand_specific.description: brand/service mark; never substituted for a generic semantic icon

invariants: Discovery does not promote or replace a production icon.
Unknown or incompatible licenses fail closed.
Every accepted SVG keeps immutable source URL and SHA-256 provenance.
Semantic role and style class are separate fields.
Penpot candidates are grouped under Icon / Candidate / <style_class>.
Production consumers continue to use linked current components until an explicit promotion receipt exists.
